answer_1.quote: Using Amazon Translate, we translated SNLI and MultiNLI from English into Turkish to create the first large Turkish NLI data sets, NLI-TR
answer_1.outputs: Translated Turkish sentences for NLI datasets

answer_4.quote: we assembled a team of ten Turkish-English bilingual speakers who were familiar with the NLI task
answer_4.guideline: We distributed an annotation guide to the team to standardize the criteria. Each expert evaluated the translation by (i) grading the translation quality between 1 and 5 ... and (ii) checking if the translation altered the semantic relation
